Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Copper
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of copper by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for copper. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-30
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

1. Sets up the simulation
2. Applies deformations

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_0/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Cu.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculations
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Original box dimensions
variable len0 equal lx
variable len1 equal ly
variable len2 equal lz

# Elastic constants calculation
variable p1 equal "v_down"
variable p2 equal "v_down"
variable p3 equal "v_down"
variable p4 equal "v_down"
variable p5 equal "v_down"
variable p6 equal "v_down"

# Calculate stress for each deformation
label loop

# Reset box and coordinates
clear
box tilt large
read_data Cu.data
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Positive deformation
change_box all x scale 1.000001 y scale 1.000001 z scale 1.000001 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Get stress tensor
variable tmp equal pxx
variable s1 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyy
variable s2 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pzz
variable s3 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyz
variable s4 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxz
variable s5 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxy
variable s6 equal ${tmp}

# Print results
print "Stress tensor components for strain ${up}:"
print "s1 = ${s1}"
print "s2 = ${s2}"
print "s3 = ${s3}"
print "s4 = ${s4}"
print "s5 = ${s5}"
print "s6 = ${s6}"

# Negative deformation
clear
box tilt large
read_data Cu.data
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

change_box all x scale 0.999999 y scale 0.999999 z scale 0.999999 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Get stress tensor
variable tmp equal pxx
variable s1n equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyy
variable s2n equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pzz
variable s3n equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyz
variable s4n equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxz
variable s5n equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxy
variable s6n equal ${tmp}

# Print results
print "Stress tensor components for strain ${down}:"
print "s1n = ${s1n}"
print "s2n = ${s2n}"
print "s3n = ${s3n}"
print "s4n = ${s4n}"
print "s5n = ${s5n}"
print "s6n = ${s6n}"

# Calculate elastic constants (in GPa, since we're using metal units)
variable C11 equal (${s1}-${s1n})/(2.0*${up})*0.0001
variable C22 equal (${s2}-${s2n})/(2.0*${up})*0.0001
variable C33 equal (${s3}-${s3n})/(2.0*${up})*0.0001
variable C44 equal (${s4}-${s4n})/(2.0*${up})*0.0001
variable C55 equal (${s5}-${s5n})/(2.0*${up})*0.0001
variable C66 equal (${s6}-${s6n})/(2.0*${up})*0.0001

# Print elastic constants
print "Elastic constants (GPa):"
print "C11 = ${C11}"
print "C22 = ${C22}"
print "C33 = ${C33}"
print "C44 = ${C44}"
print "C55 = ${C55}"
print "C66 = ${C66}"

# Calculate bulk modulus using Voigt average
# K = (C11 + C22 + C33)/9
variable bulk_modulus equal (${C11}+${C22}+${C33})/9.0
print "Bulk modulus (GPa) = ${bulk_modulus}""}
